svg.text: When the network splits, choose between refusing requests and answering
with possibly stale data, separately for each feature.
The network between two replicas breaks.
Partitions will happen, so P is not optional.
A user asks the node that can't see the
"CAP is a per-feature choice: the booking path
Partitions will happen, so the real choice is C
Choose per feature, not per system.
"Booking is CP: I'd rather reject than double-sell.
Browsing is AP: a few seconds stale is fine."
